description: This file defines a helper class for unit conversions within a cooking/recipe application, including weight and volume conversions, custom unit relations, and caching mechanisms.

classes.name: ConversionException
classes.description: Custom exception for errors during unit conversion.

classes.name: UnitConversionHelper
classes.description: Helper class providing methods for converting units, including base conversions and custom relation-based conversions.

methods.name: convert_from_to
methods.description: Converts an amount from one unit to another within the same system (weight or volume). Raises ConversionException if units are incompatible.

methods.name: base_conversions
methods.description: Generates all possible base unit conversions for a list of ingredients, caching units for efficiency.

methods.name: get_conversions
methods.description: Returns all possible conversions (including custom and base) for a given ingredient.

methods.name: _uc_convert
methods.description: Performs conversion based on a UnitConversion object, returning a converted Ingredient.
